p1.texto: It supports your wellbeing and health on board, built to work without internet and without a doctor on the ship. It tracks your vital signs, warns you when something is out of the ordinary and keeps you company. This guide takes one minute.
p2.texto: Green: everything is within what is expected. Yellow: repeat the measurement and stay alert. Red: tell the commander or a crewmate right away. Written, reviewable rules calculate it; it is not a diagnosis and an AI never decides it.
p3.texto: In the Assistant tab you can talk to Nova by text or voice, in Spanish or English. It is private: only you see it. It listens and keeps you company, but it never changes alerts or prescribes treatment. If you feel very low, it points you to the commander or a crewmate.
p4.texto: If communication drops, nothing is lost: notices wait on board and, when the link returns, the urgent ones go first. You can follow it live in the Link tab.
p5.texto: In this demo the crew and the readings are simulated and are labelled "Simulated". The thresholds have not yet been validated by a health professional: this is a prototype and does not replace a doctor.
